briefdescription.para: Phase 5 geo module hot-path release-gate benchmarks (GRG-01..GRG-06).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the geo hot paths identified in the geo module roadmap (Phase 5). Hard release gates — a p99 regression beyond 10 % vs the baseline blocks promotion.
